module_summary: Synchronous FIFO: memory array addressed by wrapping write/read pointers, fill counter derives full/empty, registered read with write-through bypass path.

anchors.name: mem
anchors.why: FIFO data array written at wr_addr, read at rd_next.

anchors.name: i_wr
anchors.why: Write request; qualified by !o_full into w_wr, also arms bypass.

anchors.name: i_data
anchors.why: Write data stored into mem or bypass register.

anchors.name: i_rd
anchors.why: Read request/consumer accept; qualified by !o_empty into w_rd.

anchors.name: o_data
anchors.why: Read data muxed from bypass_data or rd_data.

anchors.name: o_full
anchors.why: Full backpressure to writer, blocks writes.

anchors.name: o_empty
anchors.why: Empty indication to reader, blocks reads.

anchors.name: o_fill
anchors.why: Occupancy count; MSB gives full, used for empty and bypass decisions.

anchors.name: wr_addr
anchors.why: Write pointer incremented on accepted write, addresses mem.

anchors.name: rd_addr
anchors.why: Read pointer incremented on accepted read; base for rd_next.

anchors.name: r_empty
anchors.why: Registered empty flag; gates bypass capture and o_empty.

anchors.name: w_wr
anchors.why: Accepted write enable: mem write, wr_addr and fill increment.

anchors.name: w_rd
anchors.why: Accepted read enable: rd_addr increment, rd_data load.

anchors.name: REGISTERED_READ.bypass_valid
anchors.why: Selects bypass_data over rd_data for o_data.

anchors.name: REGISTERED_READ.bypass_data
anchors.why: Latches incoming write data for write-through when nearly empty.

anchors.name: REGISTERED_READ.rd_data
anchors.why: Registered memory read of next entry.

anchors.name: REGISTERED_READ.rd_next
anchors.why: Next read index rd_addr+1 for prefetch read.

groups.name: Write port
groups.description: Qualifies writes against full, advances write pointer.

groups.name: Read port with bypass
groups.description: Registered prefetch read plus write-through bypass mux driving o_data.

groups.name: Occupancy tracking
groups.description: Fill counter producing full flag and empty updates.
